headlines.title: What Does DoorDash (DASH) Entering Canada Wide Retail Delivery Mean?
headlines.summary: DoorDash (NasdaqGS:DASH) has entered a new partnership with Costco to offer on demand delivery services across Canada. Costco members in Canada can now order groceries and general merchandise through DoorDash for delivery directly to their homes. The agreement extends DoorDash's retail delivery footprint beyond restaurants by adding a major warehouse club chain to its platform. The Costco on demand delivery rollout across Canada is only one part of the broader DoorDash story.

headlines.title: Cinemark theater chain makes a food delivery push
headlines.summary: The cinema operator is promoting gameday party packs to football fans at home as more movie theaters embrace delivery.

headlines.title: DoorDash (DASH) Expands Its AI And Retail Push, Is The Upside Already Priced In?
headlines.summary: DoorDash (DASH) has rolled out a cluster of new products in recent weeks, including text based ordering, DashBuddy support tools for couriers, and expanded retail partnerships with Macy’s, Anthropologie, The North Face, Vans, and Timberland. Despite a flurry of product launches around AI ordering, DashBuddy and new retail partners, DoorDash’s recent trading has been choppy, with the share price down 9.7% over the past 30 days and the year to date share price return down 13.0%.

headlines.title: DoorDash (DASH) Stock May Look Rich After Its DashOS And AI Push
headlines.summary: DoorDash has been a volatile ride for shareholders, with big swings in the share price now putting a spotlight on whether its current US$191.24 level is really supported by the earnings behind the story. With new technology launches, retail partnerships and automation projects all in motion, the key issue for you is how much of that promise is already embedded in the stock based on what the business currently earns. Over the past 3 years the stock has delivered a return of 136.

headlines.title: TOP CHEF CANADA ANNOUNCES ITS SEASON 13 SPONSORS
headlines.summary: Today, Top Chef Canada announced Season 13 sponsors featuring six premium brand partners with custom in-show integrations, challenges, custom viewer experiences, branded prize packages, and select retail extensions. Season 13 of Top Chef Canada, last fall's #1 Lifestyle specialty program*, premieres Tuesday, October 20 at 10 p.m. ET/PT on Flavour Network and streaming exclusively on STACKTV.

description: DoorDash, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a commerce platform that connects merchants, consumers, and dashers in the United States and internationally. The company operates DoorDash Marketplace, Wolt Marketplace, and Deliveroo Marketplace, which provide various services, such as customer acquisition, demand generation, order fulfillment, merchandising, payment processing, and customer support. It also offers consumer membership programs, DashPass, Wolt+, and Deliveroo Plus; advertising as a value-added service through its marketplaces; and white-label delivery fulfillment services, as well as services that help merchants establish online ordering, build branded mobile apps, manage reservations and in-store dining, manage consumer relationships, enable tableside order and pay, and improve customer support. The company was formerly known as Palo Alto Delivery Inc. and changed its name to DoorDash, Inc. in 2015. DoorDash, Inc. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
